'''Ohann's ice rings''' were [[Planetary ring/Legends|planetary rings]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ohann]] in the [[Tatoo system/Legends|Tatoo system]]. [[Garouf Lafoe/Legends|Garouf Lafoe]], a [[free-trader]], imported [[Water/Legends|ice]] chunks from Ohann's ice rings to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="CCG-Lafoe">{{CCG|set=A New Hope Limited|cardname=Garouf Lafoe}}</ref>
